statement: XGBoost relies mainly on self-rated health (A2) and depressed mood (D2).
label: met (exploratory)
report: XGBoost relies mainly on self-rated health (A2) and depressed mood (D2). Met (exploratory): on average, self-rated health (A2) and depressed mood (D2) have 8.25 and 6.37 times the PFI of the largest other predictor, M8; the result recurs in 10 of 10 folds. The claim was formulated after the explanation was inspected; it is established only after a test on new data (csdg_confirm()).
